Dock listing copy vs MDM engineering — two different jobs

Teams assume MDM Dock policy support covers storefront language. Fleet Dock payloads and App Store Connect actually separate runtime macOS Dock governance from product-page copy:

  • Dock on the Mac — when MDM or Configuration Profiles deliver com.apple.dock-style payload rules that set Dock size, magnification, position, autohide, recent applications in Dock, minimize effect, and related appearance on enrolled macOS devices. System MDM Dock enforcement — outside AppLocale scope.
  • MDM console and server flows — IT admins configure Dock policy templates, assign Dock payloads to Mac device groups, monitor compliance when Macs show non-standard Dock posture, and remediate non-compliant devices from Jamf, Intune, Kandji, Mosyle, or your app's Dock policy editor. Payload schema and server work belong in engineering — not listing rewrite.
  • Dock marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app configures macOS Dock settings, governs Dock size and magnification, controls autohide, or standardizes Dock position on fleet Macs. An app that enforces Dock policy on Mac fleets and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other.   • Dock (this page) — MDM and Configuration Profile com.apple.dock-style payloads that configure macOS Dock appearance and behavior — Dock size, magnification, position (left/bottom/right), minimize effect, autohide Dock, show recent applications in Dock, minimize windows into application icon, animate opening applications. Gallery frames may show "Dock", "Dock size", "Magnification", "Autohide", or Dock policy editors. zh-Hans terms: 程序坞, Dock 设置, Dock 策略, 程序坞大小, 放大, 自动隐藏程序坞, MDM Dock.
  • Energy Saver (different as lead) — MDM com.apple.PowerManagement payloads that configure macOS sleep, wake, and energy posture — display sleep, system sleep, disk sleep, Power Nap, wake for network access, scheduled power — 节能 vocabulary. Energy Saver governs sleep and wake behavior; Dock governs Dock appearance after login. See Energy Saver listing when 节能 and 显示器睡眠 are your lead — not Dock size sliders.

Your gallery may show a Dock size editor on one frame and a display sleep slider on the next — but listing copy should name each claim accurately per frame. Dock vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM Dock marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate macOS Dock policy — not a literal paste of US marketing:

程序坞 (Dock)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 程序坞 alongside the English term Dock when describing MDM-configured Dock appearance on enrolled fleet Macs. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a Dock size slider needs 程序坞-friendly headlines; a technical badge may keep Dock when accurate to your English source.

Dock 设置 / Dock 策略 (Dock settings / Dock policy)

When MDM workflows mirror macOS Dock preference panels, zh-Hans enterprise docs use Dock 设置 and Dock 策略. Use when your gallery shows Dock policy editors, com.apple.dock payload panels, or "Dock settings" overlays — distinct from 节能 Energy Saver vocabulary for power management and 登录窗口 Login Window vocabulary for login-screen policy.

程序坞大小 (Dock size)

When marketing frames emphasize fleet-wide Dock size governance, use 程序坞大小 on admin-console frames showing "Dock size", "Resize Dock", or Dock size sliders — common fleet Dock controls distinct from magnification unless your frame shows magnification specifically.

放大 (magnification)

MDM policies that enable or disable Dock magnification map to 放大 on frames showing "Magnification", "Magnify icons", or magnification toggles — distinct from Dock size unless your frame shows size sliders specifically.

自动隐藏程序坞 (autohide Dock)

When Dock payloads enable or disable autohide on fleet Macs, use 自动隐藏程序坞 on frames that show autohide toggles or "Autohide Dock" overlays — common enterprise Dock posture controls.

Dock position / minimize effect / recent apps in Dock

Technical mockups may reference Dock position (left/bottom/right), minimize effect, show recent applications in Dock, minimize windows into application icon, or animate opening applications on policy editor frames. Chinese IT admin materials may use concise zh-Hans benefit lines for position and autohide while keeping Dock in English on technical overlays where buyers expect Apple terminology.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Dock search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 程序坞, Dock 设置, and 程序坞大小 each signal different intent from 节能 (Energy Saver), 登录窗口 (Login Window), 托管登录项 (Managed Login Items), or 隐私偏好策略控制 (PPPC).

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Dock" headlines on gallery frames showing Dock size sliders or magnification toggles — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

AppLocale FAQ

What is MDM Dock policy and why does listing copy matter?

Dock policy covers com.apple.dock-style payloads that configure macOS Dock appearance and behavior — Dock size, magnification, position, autohide, recent apps in Dock, minimize effect. Marketing those workflows on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does MDM Dock policy auto-translate my China listing?

No. Dock payloads are runtime MDM workflows — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for Dock apps?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines that mention Dock settings, Dock size, magnification, autohide, or Dock policy — rewritten from your English originals with terms like 程序坞, Dock 设置, and 程序坞大小 where accurate.

How is this different from Energy Saver?

Dock listing copy markets macOS Dock appearance and behavior policy. Energy Saver listing copy markets sleep, wake, and power-management policy — display sleep, Power Nap, scheduled power. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature.

How is this different from Login Window?

Dock listing copy markets Dock size, magnification, position, and autohide on enrolled Macs. Login Window listing copy markets login-screen policy before authentication — login banners, Guest Account, disable automatic login. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature.

How is this different from Managed Login Items?

Dock governs Dock UI on enrolled Macs. Managed Login Items governs allow or deny lists for Launch Agents, Launch Daemons, and background items at user login after authentication. Do not reuse Managed Login Items boilerplate on Dock-as-lead pages.

How is this different from Configuration Profiles?

Dock listing copy markets com.apple.dock-style Dock settings and appearance policy. Configuration Profile listing copy markets installable .mobileconfig distribution. Dock settings may ride inside a profile, but profile distribution is not the Dock lead. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature.

Does AppLocale configure MDM servers or deploy Dock payloads?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. MDM server deployment and com.apple.dock payload engineering are outside AppLocale scope. We rewrite how you describe existing Dock policy workflows on the store page — we do not enforce Dock size or autohide on enrolled Macs at runtime.

What character limits apply to zh-Hans Dock fields?

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters. Keywords allow up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits but should stay concise — especially overlays that must fit on-device mockups.
